meta.title: M. Muchsin (Ucin) — Portfolio
meta.description: Portfolio of M. Muchsin (Ucin) — software engineer at the intersection of Islamic scholarship and modern technology: NLP, RAG research, and web engineering.

hero.name: M. Muchsin
hero.tagline: Software engineer and researcher at the intersection of Islamic scholarship and modern technology.
hero.sub: From Pegon script transliteration to retrieval-augmented generation on HPC clusters — I build tools that make knowledge easier to access.

about.title: About
about.body_1: I grew up as a santri — an Islamic student — where classical Arabic grammar (nahwu) and the Pegon script were part of everyday study. That background shaped how I think about language: as structure, precision, and knowledge passed across generations.
about.body_2: Today I am a software engineer and master's student at UNNES, working on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and building NLP tools for Arabic-script languages. My work spans web engineering, machine learning research, and community platforms.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A selection of things I have built — from open-source language tools to client work.

items.name: Pegonku
items.description: Transliteration engine for the Pegon script — Javanese written in Arabic script — converting between Pegon and Latin with high fidelity.

items.name: Pemuda Inklusi
items.description: Community platform for inclusive youth development — built with the community, for the community.

items.name: Tokodifabel
items.description: E-commerce site for a fashion brand, from design to launch — WordPress/WooCommerce with GSAP-driven interactions.

items.name: TQA RAG Playground
items.description: Research playground for my master's thesis: a RAG pipeline over a thesis question-answering dataset, trained and evaluated on UNNES's HPC cluster.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: The fastest way to reach me is through GitHub or LinkedIn. I'm open to research collaborations, freelance work, and good conversations about language and code.
